video_variants.title: H.264 MP4 30 fps (NTSC-style)
video_variants.description: H.264 high profile 30 fps in MP4 with AAC. Covers the 30/29.97 FPS branch.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_60fps
video_variants.title: H.264 MP4 60 fps (high frame rate)
video_variants.description: H.264 high profile 60 fps in MP4 with AAC. Covers HFR branch.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_4_3_sd
video_variants.title: H.264 MP4 4:3 SD
video_variants.description: H.264 main profile 4:3 aspect at SD resolution in MP4. Covers legacy aspect branch.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_9_16_vertical
video_variants.title: H.264 MP4 9:16 Vertical (mobile)
video_variants.description: H.264 high profile 9:16 vertical aspect in MP4 with AAC. Covers mobile/vertical branch.

video_variants.name: mpeg2_ts_1080i_broadcast
video_variants.title: MPEG-2 TS 1080i Broadcast
video_variants.description: MPEG-2 Video Main@High interlaced (1080i 29.97) in MPEG-TS with MP2 stereo audio. DVB-T / ATSC broadcast profile.

video_variants.name: mpeg2_ts_480i_ntsc
video_variants.title: MPEG-2 TS 480i NTSC
video_variants.description: 480i 29.97 interlaced NTSC in MPEG-TS. Declared SAR is 8:9 because MPEG-2 cannot carry an arbitrary pixel aspect: the bitstream only encodes a small table of display aspects, so a requested 10:11 is snapped to the nearest legal value, giving a 4:3 display.

video_variants.name: mpeg4_avi_mp3_xvid
video_variants.title: MPEG-4 Part 2 (Xvid-tagged) AVI with MP3
video_variants.description: MPEG-4 Part 2 ASP in AVI tagged XVID (so legacy DivX/Xvid players recognize it) with MP3 stereo.

video_variants.name: wmv_asf_wmav2
video_variants.title: WMV2 ASF with WMA2
video_variants.description: Windows Media Video 8 (WMV2) + Windows Media Audio 2 (WMA2) in ASF/WMV container.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_pal_anamorphic
video_variants.title: H.264 MP4 PAL Anamorphic Widescreen
video_variants.description: H.264 high 720x576 PAL with SAR 64:45 (non-square pixels) so DAR resolves to exactly 16:9. Exercises anamorphic display-aspect handling.

video_variants.name: hevc_mp4_10bit_bt709_sdr
video_variants.title: HEVC MP4 10-bit BT.709 SDR (studio intermediate)
video_variants.description: HEVC main10 10-bit SDR in BT.709. Studio/intermediate content where 10-bit is for banding headroom, not HDR.

video_variants.name: chapters_mp4_10
video_variants.title: Chapters: 10 Evenly Spaced (MP4)
video_variants.description: H.264 MP4 carrying ten evenly spaced chapters with sequential titles. Baseline chapter-marker rendering.

video_variants.name: chapters_mkv_10
video_variants.title: Chapters: 10 Evenly Spaced (Matroska)
video_variants.description: Same ten chapters in Matroska, which stores chapters in its own structure rather than an MP4 chapter track.

video_variants.name: chapters_mkv_unicode
video_variants.title: Chapters: Unicode Titles
video_variants.description: Chapter titles using non-ASCII, accented, right-to-left and emoji characters. Exercises UTF-8 round-trip and client font fallback.

video_variants.name: chapters_mkv_100
video_variants.title: Chapters: 100 Chapter Stress
video_variants.description: One hundred chapters in a single file. Exercises chapter-list UI, scrubber marker density and seek-menu paging.

video_variants.name: aspect_scope_239
video_variants.title: Aspect: 2.39:1 Scope
video_variants.description: Anamorphic-scope theatrical ratio with square pixels. The most common modern cinema shape and the widest the library carries.

video_variants.name: aspect_flat_185
video_variants.title: Aspect: 1.85:1 Flat
video_variants.description: Theatrical flat ratio, slightly wider than 16:9. Exercises near-miss letterboxing on a 16:9 display.

video_variants.name: aspect_univisium_200
video_variants.title: Aspect: 2.00:1 Univisium
video_variants.description: Two-to-one ratio used widely by streaming originals. Sits between 16:9 and scope.

video_variants.name: aspect_square_1_1
video_variants.title: Aspect: 1:1 Square
video_variants.description: Square frame from social-video workflows. Neither landscape nor portrait logic applies.

video_variants.name: aspect_vertical_9_16
video_variants.title: Aspect: 9:16 True Vertical
video_variants.description: Portrait video with square pixels, as produced by phone capture. Distinct from a rotated landscape frame.

video_variants.name: aspect_letterbox_239
video_variants.title: Aspect: 2.39 Letterboxed In 16:9
video_variants.description: A 2.39 picture padded into a 16:9 coded frame, so the black bars are baked into the pixels. The container reports 16:9 and only the picture is scope — bait for auto-crop logic.

video_variants.name: aspect_pillarbox_43
video_variants.title: Aspect: 4:3 Pillarboxed In 16:9
video_variants.description: A 4:3 picture padded into a 16:9 coded frame with baked side bars. The inverse of the letterbox case.

video_variants.name: aspect_anamorphic_hdv
video_variants.title: Aspect: HDV 1440x1080 Anamorphic
video_variants.description: HDV acquisition format: 1440x1080 coded with SAR 4:3 for a 16:9 display. Non-square pixels on an HD frame.

video_variants.name: aspect_anamorphic_dvcpro
video_variants.title: Aspect: DVCPRO HD 1280x1080 Anamorphic
video_variants.description: DVCPRO HD: 1280x1080 coded with SAR 3:2 for 16:9 display.

video_variants.name: aspect_anamorphic_ntsc_wide
video_variants.title: Aspect: NTSC Widescreen Anamorphic
video_variants.description: 480-line NTSC coded 720x480 with the BT.601 sample aspect of 40:33. Across the full 720-wide frame that yields a 20:11 display aspect rather than exactly 16:9, because the 16:9 figure assumes the 704-pixel active area.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_23976
video_variants.title: H.264 23.976 fps Film Cadence
video_variants.description: The standard film frame rate. Its absence made every existing variant an integer rate, hiding NTSC pulldown and rounding bugs.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_48fps
video_variants.title: H.264 48 fps High Frame Rate
video_variants.description: Double-rate cinema capture.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_50fps
video_variants.title: H.264 50 fps PAL High Frame Rate
video_variants.description: PAL-region high frame rate broadcast.

video_variants.name: mpeg2_ts_telecine
video_variants.title: MPEG-2 3:2 Pulldown Telecine
video_variants.description: 23.976 progressive film carried as 29.97 interlaced via 3:2 pulldown. Requires inverse telecine to recover the original cadence.

video_variants.name: h264_mkv_422_10bit
video_variants.title: H.264 4:2:2 10-bit
video_variants.description: Broadcast/mezzanine chroma subsampling at 10-bit. The library was otherwise entirely 4:2:0.

video_variants.name: h264_mkv_444_8bit
video_variants.title: H.264 4:4:4 8-bit
video_variants.description: Full chroma resolution — screen capture and mastering workflows.

video_variants.name: hevc_mkv_420_12bit
video_variants.title: HEVC 12-bit
video_variants.description: Twelve-bit HEVC (Range Extensions profile). Deeper than the existing 10-bit entries.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_full_range
video_variants.title: H.264 Full-Range (PC) Levels
video_variants.description: Full-range luma rather than the usual limited/TV range. Mishandling shows as crushed blacks or clipped highlights. ffmpeg represents full range as the yuvj420p pixel format.

video_variants.name: h264_mp4_bt601
video_variants.title: H.264 BT.601 Colour Matrix
video_variants.description: Standard-definition colour matrix on an HD frame. Wrong-matrix conversion shows as a colour shift.

video_variants.name: h264_mov_aac
video_variants.title: H.264 in QuickTime MOV
video_variants.description: QuickTime container — common from Apple capture and editing tools.

video_variants.name: h263_3gp_aac
video_variants.title: H.263 in 3GP
video_variants.description: Legacy mobile format: H.263 at CIF in a 3GP container.

video_variants.name: dnxhd_mxf_pcm
video_variants.title: DNxHD in MXF
video_variants.description: Broadcast mezzanine: DNxHD 120 in MXF with PCM audio.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_eac3_51
audio_only_variants.title: E-AC-3 5.1 Audio Only
audio_only_variants.description: Enhanced AC-3 5.1 surround, raw E-AC-3 stream.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_aac_mono
audio_only_variants.title: AAC Mono Audio Only
audio_only_variants.description: AAC-LC mono in M4A. Exercises mono-track ingest / UI branch.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_pcm_714_bed
audio_only_variants.title: PCM 7.1.4 Bed (12-channel)
audio_only_variants.description: PCM 16-bit LE 7.1.4 bed (12 channels) in WAV. Covers discrete-channel object-audio bed layouts without needing proprietary Atmos metadata.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_pcm_914_bed
audio_only_variants.title: PCM 9.1.4 Bed (14-channel Atmos-style bed)
audio_only_variants.description: PCM 16-bit LE 9.1.4 bed (14 channels) in WAV. Representative of a Dolby Atmos 9.1.4 channel-based bed — objects + metadata are proprietary, but the bed itself is just multichannel PCM.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_pcm_24bit_48k
audio_only_variants.title: PCM 24-bit 48 kHz Stereo
audio_only_variants.description: PCM s24le stereo at 48 kHz in WAV. 24-bit sample depth.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_flac_24bit_96k
audio_only_variants.title: FLAC 24-bit 96 kHz Stereo (hi-res)
audio_only_variants.description: FLAC lossless stereo at 96 kHz 24-bit. Hi-res audio branch.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_flac_24bit_192k
audio_only_variants.title: FLAC 24-bit 192 kHz Stereo (studio)
audio_only_variants.description: FLAC lossless stereo at 192 kHz 24-bit. Studio-master audio branch.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_dts_51
audio_only_variants.title: DTS 5.1 Core
audio_only_variants.description: Core DTS 5.1 surround. ffmpeg can synthesize the core codec; only the lossless DTS-HD MA extension needs a licensed sample.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_truehd_51
audio_only_variants.title: Dolby TrueHD 5.1 Core
audio_only_variants.description: Core TrueHD 5.1. Atmos object metadata still requires a licensed sample.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_alac_stereo
audio_only_variants.title: ALAC Lossless Stereo
audio_only_variants.description: Apple Lossless in M4A — the Apple-ecosystem counterpart to FLAC.

audio_only_variants.name: audio_vorbis_stereo
audio_only_variants.title: Vorbis Stereo
audio_only_variants.description: Vorbis in Ogg. Predates Opus and still appears in older libraries.

subtitle_variants.name: h264_mkv_ass_embedded

subtitle_variants.description: H.264 in MP4 with mov_text embedded subtitle track.

stream_variants.name: hls_h264_aac
stream_variants.title: HLS H.264 AAC
stream_variants.description: HLS VOD with H.264 + AAC, 4 second segments.

stream_variants.name: dash_h264_aac

stream_variants.description: DASH VOD with H.264 + AAC, 4 second segments.

edge_cases.name: edge_no_audio
edge_cases.title: Edge: No Audio Track
edge_cases.description: H.264 MP4 with no audio stream.

edge_cases.name: edge_audio_only
edge_cases.title: Edge: Audio-Only File
edge_cases.description: Audio-only AAC in M4A container.

edge_cases.name: edge_multi_audio_tracks
edge_cases.title: Edge: Multiple Audio Tracks
edge_cases.description: H.264 MKV with English AAC stereo and Spanish AC-3 5.1.

edge_cases.name: edge_multi_subtitle_tracks
edge_cases.title: Edge: Multiple Subtitle Tracks
edge_cases.description: H.264 MKV with three subtitle tracks: English default, Spanish forced, Japanese.

edge_cases.name: edge_variable_fps
edge_cases.title: Edge: Variable Frame Rate
edge_cases.description: H.264 MKV with variable frame rate (VFR) timing.

edge_cases.name: edge_broken_pts
edge_cases.title: Edge: Broken Timestamps
edge_cases.description: H.264 TS with deliberately discontinuous PTS values.

edge_cases.name: edge_low_bitrate
edge_cases.title: Edge: Very Low Bitrate
edge_cases.description: H.264 MP4 encoded at an aggressive low bitrate (150 kbps video).

edge_cases.name: edge_high_bitrate_stress
edge_cases.title: Edge: High Bitrate Stress
edge_cases.description: H.264 MKV at 80 Mbps video + 640 kbps AC-3 5.1.

edge_cases.name: edge_annexb_stream
edge_cases.title: Edge: H.264 Annex B Bitstream
edge_cases.description: H.264 Annex B byte-stream format in MPEG-TS.

edge_cases.name: edge_avcc_stream
edge_cases.title: Edge: H.264 AVCC Bitstream
edge_cases.description: H.264 AVCC (length-prefixed NALU) bitstream in MP4.

edge_cases.name: edge_fragmented_mp4
edge_cases.title: Edge: Fragmented MP4
edge_cases.description: H.264 fragmented MP4 (fMP4) with empty moov and MOOF-based fragments.

edge_cases.name: edge_missing_metadata
edge_cases.title: Edge: Missing Metadata
edge_cases.description: H.264 MP4 with container and stream metadata stripped.

edge_cases.name: edge_edit_list
edge_cases.title: Edge: MP4 with Edit List (non-zero start_time)
edge_cases.description: H.264 MP4 with a 500 ms input time offset, which the MP4 muxer emits as an edts/elst edit-list entry. Covers players that ignore edit lists.

edge_cases.name: edge_truncated
edge_cases.title: Edge: Truncated File
edge_cases.description: H.264 MP4 truncated to 50% of its byte length after encoding. Simulates partial download / corrupt tail.

edge_cases.name: edge_chapters_nonzero_start
edge_cases.title: Edge: First Chapter Starts Late
edge_cases.description: Chapters begin 10% into the file, leaving an unchaptered head. Clients that assume chapter one starts at zero mis-map the timeline.

edge_cases.name: edge_chapters_overlap
edge_cases.title: Edge: Overlapping Chapters
edge_cases.description: Chapter ranges overlap each other. A player must pick one chapter per instant without flickering between markers.

edge_cases.name: edge_chapters_zero_length
edge_cases.title: Edge: Zero-Length Chapter
edge_cases.description: Contains a chapter whose start equals its end. Zero-duration markers can divide-by-zero a progress calculation.

edge_cases.name: edge_chapters_past_eof
edge_cases.title: Edge: Chapter Past End Of File
edge_cases.description: The final chapter ends beyond the file duration. Seeking to it must clamp rather than hang or error.

edge_cases.name: edge_chapters_out_of_order
edge_cases.title: Edge: Out-Of-Order Chapters
edge_cases.description: Chapters are declared with descending start times. Clients that trust declaration order build a reversed menu.

edge_cases.name: edge_chapters_stripped
edge_cases.title: Edge: Chapters Authored Then Stripped
edge_cases.description: Chapters are authored and then removed at mux time. The file must report zero chapters, proving the strip path works.

edge_cases.name: edge_rotate_90
edge_cases.title: Edge: Rotation Metadata 90
edge_cases.description: Landscape frame carrying a 90 degree display matrix, as phones record portrait video. A client that ignores the matrix shows it sideways.

edge_cases.name: edge_rotate_180
edge_cases.title: Edge: Rotation Metadata 180
edge_cases.description: Display matrix of 180 degrees — upside-down unless the client honours it.

edge_cases.name: edge_rotate_270
edge_cases.title: Edge: Rotation Metadata 270
edge_cases.description: Display matrix of 270 degrees, the opposite handedness to the 90 case.

edge_cases.name: edge_aspect_conflict
edge_cases.title: Edge: Container Aspect Conflicts With Coded Size
edge_cases.description: Coded 1280x720 but the container declares a 4:3 display aspect. Tests whether the player trusts container metadata or the coded dimensions.

edge_cases.name: edge_av_desync_500ms
edge_cases.title: Edge: Audio Delayed 500 ms
edge_cases.description: Audio deliberately offset half a second from video. Nothing else in the library tests A/V sync handling.

external_variants.name: external_dolby_vision_p5
external_variants.title: Dolby Vision Profile 5 (IPT-PQ-C2, single layer)
external_variants.description: HEVC Main10 with Dolby Vision RPU NALs, Profile 5 (single-layer, IPT-PQ-C2). Not backward compatible with HDR10 or SDR. Requires externally-supplied sample.
external_variants.license_note: Cannot be synthesized with stock ffmpeg — requires Dolby RPU tooling or a licensed sample.

external_variants.name: external_dolby_vision_p8_1
external_variants.title: Dolby Vision Profile 8.1 (HDR10-compatible base layer)
external_variants.description: HEVC Main10 with Dolby Vision RPU, Profile 8.1. Base layer is HDR10 so HDR10 devices get valid playback; DV-capable devices use RPU.
external_variants.license_note: Cannot be synthesized with stock ffmpeg — requires Dolby RPU tooling or a licensed sample.

external_variants.name: external_hdr10_plus
external_variants.title: HDR10+ Dynamic Metadata
external_variants.description: HEVC Main10 with HDR10+ dynamic tone-mapping metadata (SMPTE ST 2094-40).
external_variants.license_note: Requires hdr10plus_tool-generated metadata or a licensed sample.

external_variants.name: external_dts_hd_ma
external_variants.title: DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
external_variants.description: H.264 in MKV with DTS-HD MA lossless 5.1 track. FFmpeg cannot encode DTS-HD MA — only decode.
external_variants.license_note: DTS encoders are proprietary — sample must be obtained from a licensed source.

external_variants.name: external_truehd_atmos
external_variants.title: Dolby TrueHD with Atmos
external_variants.description: H.264 in MKV with Dolby TrueHD + Atmos object audio. FFmpeg cannot encode TrueHD.
external_variants.license_note: Dolby TrueHD encoder is proprietary — sample must be obtained from a licensed source.

external_variants.name: external_eac3_joc_atmos
external_variants.title: E-AC-3 with JOC (Dolby Digital Plus Atmos)
external_variants.description: H.264 in MP4 with Dolby Digital Plus Joint Object Coding (Atmos). FFmpeg cannot encode JOC metadata.
external_variants.license_note: Dolby Atmos encoder is proprietary — sample must be obtained from a licensed source.

external_variants.name: external_4k_hevc_real_content
external_variants.title: 4K HEVC HDR10 real-world content
external_variants.description: Real-world 4K HEVC HDR10 clip (not a test pattern) for realistic pipeline stress.

external_variants.name: external_vc1_bluray
external_variants.title: VC-1 Blu-ray sample
external_variants.description: VC-1 (SMPTE 421M) video, typical Blu-ray format. FFmpeg can decode VC-1 but has no VC-1 encoder — sample must be sourced externally.
external_variants.license_note: FFmpeg has no VC-1 encoder. Sample must be obtained from a licensed source (e.g., Blu-ray rip).

external_variants.name: external_pgs_subtitle
external_variants.title: External: PGS Blu-ray Subtitles
external_variants.description: Bitmap PGS subtitle track from a Blu-ray. ffmpeg cannot synthesize image subtitles: it refuses text-to-bitmap conversion.
external_variants.license_note: Requires a real Blu-ray-sourced PGS track. ffmpeg has no PGS encoder and cannot convert text subtitles to bitmap.

external_variants.name: external_vobsub
external_variants.title: External: VobSub DVD Subtitles
external_variants.description: Bitmap VobSub (DVD) subtitle track. Same limitation as PGS — ffmpeg can decode but not author these from text.
external_variants.license_note: Requires a real DVD-sourced VobSub track (.idx/.sub muxed into MKV).
